import backtrader as bt


class LevelRetestEntryStrategy(bt.Strategy):
    def __init__(self):
        self.support = bt.indicators.Lowest(self.data.low(-1), period=20)
        self.resistance = bt.indicators.Highest(self.data.high(-1), period=20)
        self.rsi = bt.indicators.RSI(self.data.close, period=14)
        self.atr = bt.indicators.ATR(self.data, period=14)

        self.order = None
        self.entry_side = None
        self.entry_level = None
        self.entry_atr = None
        self.entry_price = None

        self.four_hour_count = 0
        self.four_hour_open = None
        self.four_hour_close = None
        self.four_hour_bullish = None

    def notify_order(self, order):
        if order.status == order.Completed:
            if order.isbuy() and self.entry_side == "long" and self.position.size > 0:
                self.entry_price = order.executed.price
            elif order.issell() and self.entry_side == "short" and self.position.size < 0:
                self.entry_price = order.executed.price

        if order.status in [order.Completed, order.Canceled, order.Margin, order.Rejected]:
            if order.status != order.Completed and not self.position:
                self.entry_side = None
                self.entry_level = None
                self.entry_atr = None
                self.entry_price = None
            self.order = None

    def _update_four_hour_trend(self):
        if self.four_hour_count == 0:
            self.four_hour_open = self.data.open[0]

        self.four_hour_close = self.data.close[0]
        self.four_hour_count += 1

        if self.four_hour_count == 4:
            self.four_hour_bullish = self.four_hour_close > self.four_hour_open
            self.four_hour_count = 0

    def _bullish_engulfing(self):
        return (self.data.close[-1] < self.data.open[-1] and
                self.data.close[0] > self.data.open[0] and
                self.data.open[0] <= self.data.close[-1] and
                self.data.close[0] >= self.data.open[-1])

    def _bearish_engulfing(self):
        return (self.data.close[-1] > self.data.open[-1] and
                self.data.close[0] < self.data.open[0] and
                self.data.open[0] >= self.data.close[-1] and
                self.data.close[0] <= self.data.open[-1])

    def _risk_size(self, stop_level):
        stop_distance = abs(self.data.close[0] - stop_level)
        if stop_distance <= 0:
            return 0
        risk_cash = self.broker.getvalue() * 0.01
        return int(risk_cash / stop_distance)

    def next(self):
        self._update_four_hour_trend()

        if self.order:
            return

        if self.position:
            if self.entry_side == "long":
                take_profit = self.entry_price + 2.0 * self.entry_atr
                if self.data.high[0] >= take_profit or self.data.close[0] < self.entry_level:
                    self.order = self.close()
            elif self.entry_side == "short":
                take_profit = self.entry_price - 2.0 * self.entry_atr
                if self.data.low[0] <= take_profit or self.data.close[0] > self.entry_level:
                    self.order = self.close()
            return

        if self.four_hour_bullish is None:
            return

        support = self.support[0]
        resistance = self.resistance[0]

        if (self.four_hour_bullish and
                self.data.low[0] <= support and
                self.data.close[0] > support and
                self._bullish_engulfing() and
                self.rsi[0] > 50):
            size = self._risk_size(support)
            if size > 0:
                self.entry_side = "long"
                self.entry_level = support
                self.entry_atr = self.atr[0]
                self.order = self.buy(size=size)
        elif (not self.four_hour_bullish and
                self.data.high[0] >= resistance and
                self.data.close[0] < resistance and
                self._bearish_engulfing() and
                self.rsi[0] < 50):
            size = self._risk_size(resistance)
            if size > 0:
                self.entry_side = "short"
                self.entry_level = resistance
                self.entry_atr = self.atr[0]
                self.order = self.sell(size=size)

assumptions.choice: Support and resistance are respectively the lowest low and highest high of the 20 completed bars immediately preceding the signal bar.
assumptions.reason: The specification defines local lows/highs over the last 20 bars but does not say whether the signal bar is included; completed preceding bars avoid moving the level while testing it.

assumptions.choice: A touch occurs when the signal bar low is at or below support (or high is at or above resistance), and a bounce requires its close to finish back above support (or below resistance).
assumptions.reason: The specification requires a touch or break followed by a bounce but does not provide numeric definitions.

assumptions.choice: Bullish and bearish engulfing patterns are used, with the prior candle opposite-colored and the current real body fully engulfing the prior real body; equality at body boundaries is accepted.
assumptions.reason: The specification gives engulfing and hammer/hanging-man as examples without selecting one or defining their geometry.

assumptions.choice: Four consecutive hourly feed bars are aggregated into a non-overlapping four-bar candle; its trend is bullish when close is greater than open and bearish otherwise, and the latest completed aggregate is used.
assumptions.reason: Only one hourly data feed is supplied, so the requested four-times-larger timeframe must be constructed manually; the specification does not define aggregation anchoring or a trend measure.

assumptions.choice: Position size is the integer floor of 1% of current broker equity divided by the distance from signal close to the entry level.
assumptions.reason: The allowed range is 1-2%; 1% is the conservative endpoint, while whole-share sizing and signal-close estimation are required by the execution model.

assumptions.choice: ATR(14) is snapshotted on the signal bar, and the take-profit is two times that ATR from the actual executed entry price; the exit triggers when a bar high reaches the long target or a bar low reaches the short target.
assumptions.reason: The specification does not state whether ATR should remain fixed or vary after entry; bar extremes give the literal reading of price moving the required distance.

assumptions.choice: Entries and exits use Backtrader market orders, so signal-close sizing can differ from risk measured from the eventual fill price if the next bar gaps.
assumptions.reason: The specification does not state order type, and the fixed harness uses Backtrader execution semantics.
